diagrams.title: Diagrams
diagrams.textHint: Use 2 to 12 lines, at most 180 characters per item.
diagrams.hierarchyHint: Use one root item and indent with 2 spaces or one tab per level. At most 24 items and 5 levels.
diagrams.nativeShapes: The new diagram contains ordinary shapes. Text, colors and positions remain editable. Ungroup it via Arrange.
diagrams.readOnly: This text structure is preserved and cannot yet be edited here.
diagrams.noText: No editable diagram text was found.
diagrams.shared: This diagram shares source data or a drawing cache with another diagram. Text editing is disabled.
diagrams.paragraphHint: Keep the paragraph count per item in existing diagrams; formatting is preserved.
diagrams.sameParagraphs: Keep the same number of lines per item as in the original text.
diagrams.convertHint: Conversion replaces this SmartArt object with an ordinary shape group. Its SmartArt layout can no longer be configured. Ungroup it via Arrange; all other diagrams are preserved.
diagrams.noCache: This diagram has no stored shape drawing. Text editing may be available; conversion is not yet supported.
diagrams.cacheUnsupported: This drawing cache cannot be converted reliably. The diagram remains unchanged.
diagrams.reloadHint: A change reloads the presentation and clears the current undo history.
diagrams.failed: The operation could not be completed. Check the text and the supported diagram structure.
diagrams.stale: The diagram has changed. Close this window and open it again.
diagrams.previewFailed: Could not draw the preview. The original diagram is preserved.

print.imageUnreadable: The image could not be read.

export.pngNeedsEditor: Open the presentation in the editor to save a slide as PNG.

sorter.title: Slide Sorter
sorter.label: Slides in grid view
sorter.reloadHint: The presentation is then reloaded; earlier steps can no longer be undone.
sorter.packageFailed: This change could not be applied to the file.
sorter.keepOne: At least one slide must remain.
sorter.duplicated: Duplicated; the presentation has been reloaded.
sorter.shown: Unhidden; the presentation has been reloaded.
sorter.hidden: Hidden; the presentation has been reloaded. The slide show skips hidden slides.
sorter.sectionExists: A section already starts at this slide. Rename that section or choose another slide.
sorter.sectionAdded: Section added; the presentation has been reloaded.
sorter.sectionRenamed: Section renamed; the presentation has been reloaded.
sorter.sectionRemoved: Section removed (the slides remain); the presentation has been reloaded.
sorter.hint: Drag to rearrange · Double-click opens the slide · Ctrl/Shift+click selects more slides

show.popupBlocked: The presenter view window was blocked; allow pop-up windows for this site.
show.endOfShow: End of slide show. Click or press a key to exit.
show.clearInk: Erase all ink on this slide
show.keysHint: Number + Enter jumps · B/W black/white · P pen · H highlighter · L laser · E erase ink · Esc ends

outline.title: Outline
outline.changed: This text has changed in the meantime. Please try again.

objects.title: Objects and position
objects.one: Choose one object to edit its dimensions.
objects.gone: The object or slide no longer exists.
objects.invalid: Enter valid coordinates and positive dimensions.

footers.title: Slide numbers and footer
footers.invalidSelection: Choose existing slide numbers or ranges, for example 1, 3-5.
footers.automaticHint: Date fields are updated when applied. Other presentation software may also update them when opened.

design.name: Name
design.layoutHelp: Reset keeps text and custom objects. Only unused layouts can be deleted.
design.reload: This change reloads the presentation and starts a new undo history.
design.inheritance: Linked slides inherit this background unless they have their own background.
design.image: Image (PNG or JPEG, up to 20 MB)

errors.invalid: Enter valid values and a valid slide range.
errors.inUse: This layout is still in use.
errors.lastLayout: A master must keep at least one layout.
errors.missing: The document has changed. Open this dialog again.
errors.themeFile: Choose a valid Open Office Studio theme file.
errors.themeTooLarge: Use a theme file up to 64 KB.
errors.themeSave: The theme could not be saved. Try again.

design.themeFileHelp: Exchange colors, font names and background as an Open Office Studio theme (.oos-theme). Import previews the theme; Apply changes the selected slides. Font files are not included.
design.importedTheme: Theme imported. Review it, then apply or save it.

tables.title: Tables
tables.help: Edit cell text. Shift+click or enter a cell range to select multiple cells. Ctrl+V pastes a table from a spreadsheet or text document.

errors.invalid: Enter valid table values or a valid cell range.
errors.partialMerge: The selection cuts through a merged cell. Split that cell first.
errors.tooLarge: Use at most 200 rows, 50 columns and 5000 cells.
errors.missing: The table or document has changed. Open this dialog again.

reuse.title: Reuse slides
reuse.help: Choose slides to insert after the current slide. Source formatting is retained; internally linked slides are included. In the sorter use Ctrl+C, then Ctrl+V or Paste slides.

errors.invalid: The presentation or selection is invalid or has changed.
errors.size: The source has a different slide size. Use the same slide size for this copy.
errors.notes: The source uses a different notes master. This combination cannot yet be inserted without loss.
errors.metadata: Embedded fonts or comment authors cannot yet be merged without loss here.
errors.tooLarge: Use at most 500 slides and a source package up to 100 MB. Clipboard copies may be at most 32 MB.

errors.invalid: Enter valid crop and transparency values, or choose a valid PNG/JPEG image.
errors.missing: No picture is available, or the document has changed. Open this dialog again.
errors.tooLarge: Use a PNG/JPEG up to 20 MB and 50 million pixels.

transitions.title: Slide transitions
transitions.previewFailed: The preview could not be drawn.
transitions.soundHint: Embedded sounds play during the slide show and are preserved in the file. Linked files are not loaded automatically.
transitions.unknownHint: Existing effects are kept per slide. Unsupported effects play without animation. Choose another effect to replace them.
transitions.invalidTiming: Use a duration from 0 to 60 seconds and a delay from 0 to 86400 seconds. Enable mouse click or automatic advance.
transitions.invalidSound: Choose a valid PCM or float WAV file up to 10 MB.
transitions.soundFailed: The transition sound could not be played.

showFile.title: Open slide-show file
showFile.explanation: This file is intended as a slide show. Would you like to edit it or play it from the first slide?

animations.title: Object animations
animations.empty: This slide has no object animations.
animations.invalid: Check the numbers: duration 0–60 s, delay 0–3600 s, path −1000–1000% and rotation −3600–3600°.
animations.unsupported: This slide contains unsupported animation timing. It is fully preserved. Editing is disabled; the show displays the slide without object animations.
animations.renderFailed: The object animations could not be rendered. The slide is shown without object animations; settings are preserved.
animations.nativeHint: The separate desktop viewer displays this slide without object animations. Settings are preserved.
animations.noObjects: This slide has no objects to animate.
animations.previewFailed: The animation preview could not be drawn.

groups.help: Choose at least two objects. The group takes the highest stack position of the selection.
groups.ungroupHelp: Choose the group to ungroup. Its children retain their visible positions.
groups.name: Group name

errors.invalid: Choose at least two objects and enter a name.
errors.missing: The group or document has changed. Open this dialog again.
errors.unsupported: This selection contains placeholders, locks, group effects, animation targets or transforms that cannot yet be flattened without changing the result.

media.empty: Add a video or audio file.
media.limit: MP4, WebM, MP3, M4A or WAV, up to 50 MiB per file. Playback depends on available codecs.

media.invalidFile: Choose a valid MP4, WebM, MP3, M4A or WAV file up to 50 MiB.

media.invalidTrim: Start and end trim must total less than the file duration.

media.external: This media links to an external file. The link is preserved; nothing is fetched.
media.missing: The embedded media file is missing.
media.readOnly: This existing media structure is preserved. Its playback settings cannot yet be edited here.
media.posterFailed: Could not capture the video frame.
media.showUnsupported: Some media remain as posters because of groups, stacking order, object animations or unsupported timing. Preview them via Insert → Video and audio.
media.nativeHint: The separate desktop audience window currently shows video posters. The video preview plays in presenter view.

formatCopy.help: Copy formatting on this slide. The first source paragraph and text style apply to all target text. Text, links and positions are retained.
